SELECT A.ALARM_SEQ AS alarmSeq, A.ALARM_NAME AS alarmName, A.ALARM_TYPE AS alarmType, A.ALARM_MAIL_YN AS alarmMailYn, A.ALARM_SMS_YN AS alarmSmsYn, A.ALARM_MONITOR_YN AS alarmMonitorYn, A.ALARM_CYCLE AS alarmCycle, A.ALARM_CYCLE_VAL AS alarmCycleVal, A.ALARM_WEEK AS alarmWeek, A.ALARM_TIME AS alarmTime,
if(A.ALARM_TO is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, A.ALARM_TO)) AS alarmTo, if(A.ALARM_CC is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, A.ALARM_CC)) AS alarmCC,
A.ALARM_TO AS alarmTo, A.ALARM_CC AS alarmCC,
A.ALARM_FORM_SEQ AS alarmFormSeq, A.ALARM_VAL AS alarmVal, DATE_FORMAT(A.CTIME,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.USER_NM AS userNm, A.USER_HP AS userHp, A.USE_YN AS useYn, A.CSV_YN AS csvYn, A.EXCEL_MAX_CNT AS excelMaxCnt, B.FORM_SEQ AS formSeq, B.FORM_SUBJECT AS formSubject, B.FORM_CONTENT AS formContent, B.FORM_COMMENT AS formComment FROM UI_ALARM A LEFT JOIN UI_ALARM_FORM B ON A.ALARM_FORM_SEQ = B.FORM_SEQ WHERE ALARM_SEQ = BINARY(#{alarmSeq})

SELECT ALARM_SEQ AS alarmSeq, ALARM_NAME AS alarmName, ALARM_TYPE AS alarmType, ALARM_MAIL_YN AS alarmMailYn, ALARM_SMS_YN AS alarmSmsYn, ALARM_MONITOR_YN AS alarmMonitorYn, ALARM_CYCLE AS alarmCycle, ALARM_CYCLE_VAL AS alarmCycleVal, ALARM_TIME AS alarmTime, ALARM_WEEK AS alarmWeek,
if(ALARM_TO is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, ALARM_TO)) AS alarmTo, if(ALARM_CC is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, ALARM_CC)) AS alarmCC,
ALARM_TO AS alarmTo, ALARM_CC AS alarmCC,
ALARM_FORM_SEQ AS alarmFormSeq, ALARM_VAL AS alarmVal, DATE_FORMAT(CTIME,'%Y-%m-%d %T') AS createDt, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NM AS userNm, USER_HP AS userHp, USE_YN AS useYn, CSV_YN AS csvYn, EXCEL_MAX_CNT AS excelMaxCnt FROM UI_ALARM WHERE 1=1
AND ALARM_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
ORDER BY CTIME

SELECT ADMIN_ID AS adminId, ADMIN_NAME AS adminName,
if(ADMIN_EMAIL is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, ADMIN_EMAIL)) AS adminEmail,
ADMIN_EMAIL AS adminEmail,
MAX(CONM) AS coNm, MAX(BUSINM) AS busiNm FROM ( SELECT X.ADMIN_ID, X.ADMIN_NAME, X.ADMIN_EMAIL, Y.CONM, Z.BUSINM FROM UI_ADMIN X LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.ADMIN_ID, A.COCD, A.CONM FROM UI_CO A JOIN UI_ADMIN_CO B ON A.COCD = B.COCD )Y ON X.ADMIN_ID = Y.ADMIN_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT B.ADMIN_ID, A.BUSICD, A.BUSINM FROM UI_BUSI A JOIN UI_ADMIN_BUSI B ON A.BUSICD = B.BUSICD )Z ON X.ADMIN_ID = Z.ADMIN_ID WHERE IFNULL(X.ADMIN_EMAIL, '') != '' ) AS RS WHERE 1=1
AND ( RS.ADMIN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR RS.ADMIN_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') OR
if(RS.ADMIN_EMAIL is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, RS.ADMIN_EMAIL))
RS.ADMIN_EMAIL
LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%') )
GROUP BY ADMIN_ID, ADMIN_NAME, ADMIN_EMAIL ORDER BY ADMIN_NAME, ADMIN_EMAIL
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(ALARM_SEQ),0)+1 AS alarmSeq FROM UI_ALARM

INSERT INTO UI_ALARM (ALARM_SEQ, ALARM_NAME, ALARM_TYPE, ALARM_MAIL_YN, ALARM_SMS_YN, ALARM_MONITOR_YN, ALARM_CYCLE, ALARM_CYCLE_VAL, ALARM_WEEK, ALARM_TIME, ALARM_TO, ALARM_CC, ALARM_FORM_SEQ, ALARM_VAL, CTIME, USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_HP, USE_YN, CSV_YN, EXCEL_MAX_CNT) VALUES ((SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(A.ALARM_SEQ AS UNSIGNED)),1000)+1 FROM UI_ALARM A), #{alarmName}, #{alarmType}, #{alarmMailYn}, #{alarmSmsYn}, #{alarmMonitorYn}, #{alarmCycle}, #{alarmCycleVal}, #{alarmWeek}, #{alarmTime},
if(#{alarmTo} is null, null, xcnenc(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, #{alarmTo})), if(#{alarmCC} is null, null, xcnenc(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, #{alarmCC})),
#{alarmTo}, #{alarmCC},
#{alarmFormSeq}, #{alarmVal}, NOW(), #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{userHp}, #{useYn}, #{csvYn}, #{excelMaxCnt} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM UI_ALARM WHERE ALARM_SEQ IN (#{alarmSeq})

SELECT DISTINCT A.ALARM_SEQ AS alarmSeq, A.ALARM_NAME AS alarmName, A.ALARM_TYPE AS alarmType, A.ALARM_CYCLE AS alarmCycle, A.ALARM_CYCLE_VAL AS alarmCycleVal, A.ALARM_WEEK AS alarmWeek, A.ALARM_TIME AS alarmTime,
if(A.ALARM_TO is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, A.ALARM_TO)) AS alarmTo, if(A.ALARM_CC is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, A.ALARM_CC)) AS alarmCC,
A.ALARM_TO AS alarmTo, A.ALARM_CC AS alarmCC,
A.ALARM_FORM_SEQ AS alarmFormSeq, A.ALARM_VAL AS alarmVal, A.ALARM_MAIL_YN AS alarmMailYn, A.ALARM_SMS_YN AS alarmSmsYn, A.ALARM_MONITOR_YN AS alarmMonitorYn, D.ADMIN_HP AS userHp, A.CSV_YN AS csvYn, A.EXCEL_MAX_CNT AS excelMaxCnt, CTIME AS createDt, USER_ID AS userId, USER_NM AS userNm, C.FORM_SUBJECT AS formSubject, C.FORM_CONTENT AS formContent FROM UI_ALARM A LEFT JOIN UI_ALARM_LOG B ON A.ALARM_SEQ = B.ALARM_SEQ LEFT JOIN UI_ALARM_FORM C ON A.ALARM_FORM_SEQ = C.FORM_SEQ LEFT JOIN UI_ADMIN D ON A.USER_ID = D.ADMIN_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( ( B.ETIME IS NULL OR ( DATE_FORMAT(B.ETIME,'%Y%m%d') != DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') ) ) AND A.ALARM_TIME = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(),'%H') AND A.ALARM_CYCLE = 'D' ) OR ( A.ALARM_CYCLE = 'H' ) OR ( ( B.ETIME IS NULL OR (DATE_FORMAT(B.ETIME,'%Y%m%d') != DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') ) ) AND A.ALARM_WEEK = DAYOFWEEK(NOW()) AND A.ALARM_TIME = DATE_FORMAT( NOW(),'%H') ) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_ALARM_LOG (ALARM_LOG_SEQ, ALARM_SEQ, ETIME, RMSG, RCNT) VALUES ((SELECT IFNULL(MAX(A.ALARM_LOG_SEQ)+1,1001) FROM UI_ALARM_LOG A), #{alarmSeq}, NOW(), #{query}, #{totalCnt})
